title: Add automatic card pictures and a live board workspace
body: ## Summary Emoji can be too ambiguous for a child's communication board, and the existing draft modal makes it difficult to review a board while refining it. This adds automatic pictures and a full-page draft workspace. It keeps suitable emoji, fills gaps with licensed artwork, and generates pictures only when needed. Parents can choose picture sources, stop work and explicitly save the draft. Failed picture work leaves usable cards; personal photos, protected pictures and saved offline PNGs are preserved. Inline notices explain picture processing before use. New board opens the conversation; Build manually remains available separately. The web introduction lives at `/`, with the app at `/app` and existing installed-app entry preserved. [Picture behavior and configuration](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/2be85f0cb02cd5ba464f46c623b9b19cf5061231/docs/PICTURES.md). Tracks #16. Targets master; review this before dependent #15. ## Test plan and evidence - **Create a board:** requesting cow, sheep and a dump truck retained the animal emoji and added the distinct truck picture, as shown below. - **Recover safely:** browser tests confirmed fallback cards remain saveable, stopped work releases capacity, failed saves can be retried, and saved cards survive reload/offline use. Source restrictions and protected photos remain respected. - **Edit and disclose:** saved words survive dismissal of optional pictures; duplicate-label cards retain the correct pictures. Setup and parent settings explain picture-data use before generation. Current CI passed **205 unit/server tests**, type/release checks and builds. **32 browser scenarios** passed on the unchanged mobile source. [Checks and recovery](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#issuecomment-6001954640) · [Detailed results and source applicability](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/1fd973b318313dc1f1e524f7a1e71f245380d29b/docs/review/pr6-catalog-cancel/README.md). The genuine pairs compare master with the proposed behavior using matched synthetic data and viewports. Controlled service replies demonstrate UI behavior, not live AI accuracy. Captures predate backend-only fixes or changes outside the shown state; their original revisions and applicability remain recorded in the [draft/web capture manifest](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/7a0e75f01b51550c1027e640e67b118faceb2e65/docs/review/pr6-save/manifest.json), [disclosure evidence](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/tree/c5b713150eee315fc6ddb5ea62cb4ff071e5bbcb/docs/review/pr6-disclosure) and [preserved provenance explanation](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/tree/6600f14dbc81aa9fd034885d162dde14a0535d41/docs/review/pr6-concise/original-pr.md). No pixels were edited. Truck artwork: Mulberry Symbols, Steve Lee, CC BY-SA 4.0. ### picture draft Automatic pictures replace the ambiguous truck emoji while the full-page workspace keeps the draft beside the conversation. Browser evidence only; physical Android/iPad and live paid-provider accuracy were not tested. Unsaved conversation drafts remain in memory. The API-rendered body is inspectable, but authenticated GitHub-page inspection remains blocked by browser access. [Independent QA](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/6#issuecomment-6002210899) must reassess the revised presentation before readiness.
